name: Tessera Industries Deep Scan Penetrating Radar DSR-1
product_name: Tessera Industries Deep Scan Penetrating Radar DSR-1
description: A portable ground-penetrating and wall-penetrating radar system that creates detailed 3D maps of structures, underground spaces, and the contents of sealed containers. The DSR-1 emits ultra-wideband radar pulses that penetrate up to 10 meters through standard construction materials, 3 meters through reinforced concrete, and 20 meters through soil. The return signals are processed into a real-time 3D visualization displayed on the operator's neural interface or a tablet screen. The system can detect human-sized objects through walls, identify voids and hidden chambers in structures, and map underground tunnel networks from the surface.

specifications.visualization: Real-time 3D on neural interface or tablet

story_hooks: A DSR-1 scan of an unremarkable building revealed a hidden sub-basement that does not appear on any architectural plan — the space is occupied and powered, and its contents are shielded from deeper scanning.
Someone has been using a DSR-1 to map the location of wall safes in residential buildings from the exterior — a string of burglaries targets hidden safes that the victims believed were undetectable.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, ergonomic handheld scanner resembling a high-tech surveying tool crossed with a tactical device. The main body is cylindrical-tapered, widening slightly at the grip section, with a pronounced directional antenna array protruding from the front face. The overall silhouette suggests precision instrumentation with purposeful industrial design.
physical_description.dimensions: 38 cm long, 8 cm diameter at grip, antenna head 12 cm wide
physical_description.weight_description: Handheld but substantial—2.5 kg requires a secure grip or shoulder strap for extended fieldwork
physical_description.primary_material: Aircraft-grade aluminum chassis with reinforced polymer grip panels
physical_description.finish: Matte gunmetal with anodized accents; textured grip sections for moisture resistance
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal gray primary body with deep cyan accent lines along the antenna array and control panel; matte black grip zones
physical_description.interface_elements: Small 4-inch flexscreen display on the upper grip section showing real-time waveform data; three capacitive touch controls (scan/pause/mode); micro-USB and neural-link induction port on the base; status indicator LEDs (amber, cyan, red) clustered near the antenna feed
distinctive_features: Phased-array antenna head with visible radiator elements arranged in a honeycomb matrix
Cyan running lights along the antenna perimeter that pulse during active scanning
Dual-axis gimbal mounting points for tripod or vehicle attachment
Recessed cable conduit running the length of the body
Tessera Industries holographic warranty seal on the lower grip
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: TESSERA INDUSTRIES embossed vertically along the grip; DSR-1 model number with serial barcode on the battery compartment; GLMZ certification stamps; ultra-wideband frequency warning label near antenna
physical_description.condition_typical: In fieldwork, the device is held at various angles with the antenna face directed toward target surfaces; often strapped to tactical vests or carried in a weatherproof hard case; the flexscreen displays constantly updating 3D voxel clouds and depth metrics
